reading: The camps are nine li apart. 相距离 duplicates the relation.
The state and the numerical distance must both survive. The unexpanded 去 remains classical.
The axe is raised but 目之 still needs the act of staring.
The reported claim about lifting a weight must read as a sentence.
The beacon is feigned and raised by people still unwilling to surrender. Several choices remain syntactically opaque.
廖立 is a person being summoned.
客之 loses the generous hospitality.
A succinct modern attack on Yi preserves both parties.
荐举 is already a viable expression. 荐推荐 duplicates it.
The complete modern answer preserves the boatmen, abandoned boat and joint departure.
The clipped 感谢封 loses the enfeoffment.
到命令 fails to express acting under orders in modern Chinese.
The removed hats and kowtow are part of the apology. The shorter answers remain classical.
The target is our southern border. 邾 is a valid abbreviated state name.
The source's 能 is a personal name and 徐 means slowly.
进感谢 and 进谢 are malformed.
The political criticism depends on the younger son and inversion of succession.
The wish to attack Wei matters.
The object is an elm. An attack on an elm gives the wrong reading.
The officials investigate and report unlawful conduct.
The sequence of dancing and leaving is retained by the three modernized variants.
The reported recommendation of Jue was apt. 举起 selects a physical lifting.
The source itself conveys gratitude but remains classical. The fourth modernized option leaves the object phrased awkwardly.
The amazement of relatives and friends accompanies the return home.
相距 is sufficient. 相距离 adds an unnecessary glyph.
A threat about urination, not death.
The ambiguous shorthand 徐 and 案 impair a complete modern rendering. 推荐 gives the wrong action.
The required modern reading concerns succession and far-reaching glory.
The boat does not leave.
粮食 invents a gift of grain.
The short mixed-register form retains the distance but leaves 不盈 and the river badly expressed.
The hypothetical asks about exercising authority and the accomplishments of two ministers.
The recipient of throwing is the water. 扔到水 is incomplete modern phrasing.
The object of releasing and permitting departure is needed.
Only this point was meant.
The modernized short answers retain departure but leave the archaic 辞众.
The military command relation is absent from the malformed 公子申队.
荐推荐 repeats the idea and the source already contains a word for recommendation.
The beacon and its location north of Anyang must be clear.
Plundering followed by departure is intact.
The agent is Wen Jiao. The intended action is leaving Wang Dun.
The exchange concerns possible longevity.
The prime minister died before recommending Bowen.
The name of the Qin official and attack on Song survive in the two modernized versions.
The reference's additional 乾 before the military title is uncertain. None is a secure complete modern reading.
彼 leaves an archaic demonstrative and 的 loses it.
The brief attack on Yuan remains a complete proposition.
The compassion of a ruler grounds both governance and the simile.
The apology for lack of talent is reversed by 感谢有才能. The bare source is ambiguous.
